subject: Quick ask: 10-min Capterra micro-case + e-gift
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask: 10-min Capterra micro-case + e-gift

Hi Marta,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the pilot — the integration you ran with the triage model produced exactly the kind of latency improvements we were hoping to see. Quick ask: would Acme be willing to share a short micro-case on Capterra (2-3 sentences + a 10-minute sync) about the pilot and the business impact?

We typically ask for a very brief quote and, if helpful, a quick 10-minute recording or call to capture one or two specific metrics you can share (time saved, throughput change, etc.). As a thank-you we provide a $75 Amazon e-gift card after the review is posted.

I attached our micro-case guidelines (very short) and a sample set of prompts we use to help folks write a 2-3 sentence blurb. If you're up for it, what does your availability look like next week for a 10-minute slot?

Attachments: microcase-guidelines.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: 415-555-0186 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

--
Redwood Inference — inference that scales with predictable cost
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>

Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800

Thanks, Dylan — happy to help. We can do a quick 10-minute call to capture the specific numbers. I can also draft a 2-3 sentence quote after the call.

I’m available: Monday 11/10 10:00–10:30 PT or Tuesday 11/11 09:00–09:30 PT. Either works.

Marta
Director of Clinical Operations
Acme Health

Subject: Fulfillment + review link (Capterra)

Hi Marta — Ben from Customer Advocacy here, thanks again for agreeing to share your feedback. Per Dylan’s note, posting a short review on Capterra is perfect.

To make it easy, here are two options (pick one):

1) Quick post now: use this direct link to leave a brief review (2–3 sentences) — https://www.capterra.com/r/review/redwood-inference (this will take ~5 minutes).

2) Prefer to record? Reply to this email with the 10-minute recording attached and we’ll take the quote verbatim.

We’ll send the $75 Amazon e-gift card after the post is verified. Attached is a small info/fulfillment PDF for the gift card.

Attachments: amazon-75-fulfillment.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

If helpful, we can also share a one-paragraph case snippet for your marketing team to approve before publication.

Thanks again, Marta — please let us know which option you prefer and we’ll follow up immediately.

Best,
